## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [Juni 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.135
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.135
- Datum: 06.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
Dear Hannah and Manfred, there are not much news about us,
Lotte is a bit better but I hope that when the systematic
treatment begins she will be perfectly alright. Now summer
is approaching and we have not yet made up our minds
what to do. I hate to go to the country here as in the
hotels of this kind I would find no place to work quietly
and all is so far and we have no experience what would
be convenient to us - The others have now taken houses
in California because the climate is perfect there, but
we as visitors cannot do this. Newyork is terrible
during the summer and an air-conditionate apparte-
ment would be the only possibility but the prices
are fantastic. Going to Brazil would be the best but
we see not yet a possibility or probability in case
of Americas entrance into the war to come
back (except immigrating what we would of course
avoid.) So we see not yet any solutions and time
flies (with black wings). And you may imagine how
I am longing to sit somewhere quietly and to work
in continuity. The terrifying doom comes nearer and
nearer and I must hurry to do what I have to do
- but who can act today after his own wishes? For
your friend Fridlauer dont worry, he has already announ-
ced here that he writes in Brazil the biografie of the
President and I suppose he will be soon
here to meet all the others Fridlauers. You underrate
him, there is a hint of genius in him to overcome
all difficulties and the darker the waters the better he swims. I
his tenacity and courage. We are not fit enough for such
times with our "alergic" moral conscience.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief in violetter Tinte. Am linken Rand befindet sich ein vertikal geschriebener Textabsatz, der hier in die Transkription integriert wurde (beginnend mit 'all difficulties...').
Farbskala und Grauskala für Archivierung. Der Text ist durch die Skalen teilweise verdeckt, entspricht dem Text von Seite 1.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist trotz der handschriftlichen Kursivschrift und der vertikalen Randnotiz gut lesbar. Die englische Sprache ist flüssig und der Kontext klar.
